thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-34217 fired for service=redwood-inference/inference-gateway-prod — metric=error_rate_5xx, threshold=3% over 2m. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-34217

pagerbot: Autopage summary: group=inference-gateway-prod-eu, triggered at 2026-03-14T00:03:54Z. 5xx spike: 6.8% -> current 7.2%. approx affected rps=2500, estimated failed/min=1500.

sre-oncall: ack PD-34217. I'm the primary oncall, taking lead. @lina @omar please standby for handoff if needed.

lina: ack — pulling logs now. seeing 502s from kv-cache timeouts + 503s from model-hosts. Canary cluster has higher error rate.

omar: grabbing recent deploys. 06:57 canary rollout for inference-gateway v2.3.4 completed ~6m before alert. Correlating.

kevin: tagging as potential regression + capacity issue. rerouting suggestions in runbook.

marie: pinging support to prepare customer comms for any sustained degradation. will list top impacted orgs in 5m.

incident-bot: Runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/inference/5xx-spike. Recommended immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant 2) scale gateway and model hosts 3) drain canary nodes.

sre-oncall: performing step 1: enabling fallback routing (20% traffic -> redwood-compact). Command: `rdctl traffic-shift --service inference-gateway --target redwood-compact --percent 20 --env prod`

lina: running quick scale: scaling inference-gateway deploy from 20 -> 60 replicas in prod (autoscaling temporarily disabled to avoid oscillation).

omar: rolling back canary v2.3.4 to last-known-good (v2.3.3) on canary pool. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/inference-gateway inference=registry/redwood/inference:v2.3.3 -n prod-canary`

support-bot: Noted. Top affected customers: Acme Corp (100k reqs/day), BrightHealth (50k reqs/day), Edify (20k reqs/day). Preparing banners if error persists.

kevin: also enabling emergency capacity bump on model-host pool (dedicated) to add 4x instances until autoscaler stabilizes.

lina: logs snippet (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-14T00:02:10Z] ERROR inference-gateway request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream=kv-cache timeout_ms=1200
[2026-03-14T00:02:12Z] ERROR model-host id=mh-7 status=503 oom_kill=false accept_queue=full
```

omar: after rollback + routing shift + scale: observing downward trend. 5xx -> 2.1% over last 2 min. still above threshold but improving.

sre-oncall: good. keeping 20% fallback for now and watching latency impact. @kevin can you keep the capacity bump for +10m?

kevin: capacity bump active + will hold for 15m. monitoring CPU/GPU utilization, will notify before scale-down.

marie: support has opened a triage thread with top customers and prepped status updates. No public status page update yet — will wait for stable <1%.

pagerbot: PD note: escalation policy suppressed (primary acked) — no escalation to SRE lead. PD incident remains acknowledged.

lina: running additional KV cache warmups and TTL adjustments to reduce cold misses. Posted small script to /ops: `scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh --region eu --parallel 10`

sre-oncall: current metrics snapshot: 5xx=0.9% (5m avg), p50 latency +3ms, p95 +35ms. I'm scheduling check-in at +30m for incident update.

support-bot: customers notified: Acme - contacted, BrightHealth - contacted, Edify - contacted. No visible revenue-impact flags yet.

kevin: preparing short post-incident timeline and next actions: 1) full rollback verification 2) canary config audit 3) add pre-warm to deploy runbook 4) tweak autoscaler cooldowns.

sre-oncall: thanks team. keeping channel open for 30m, then will move to postmortem thread if stable. If 5xx >1.5% return, re-open paging.

incident-bot: PD-34217 transitioning to "resolved" after acknowledgement window and metrics stable per incident policy. Please file follow-up in #postmortems with timeline and root cause hypotheses. :white_check_mark:
